english.title: AATF operator/approved exporter fail to include details in tonnes of non-obligated WEEE in report (pre 2019)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an

(A)_[operator of an AATF,]_
(B)_[approved exporter,]_

in providing a report, namely **(..SPECIFY REPORT..) to **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, in accordance with regulation 66(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013, failed to include details of the total amount in tonnes of non-obligated WEEE received by you
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 66(3), 90(7)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
